scope.task_classification: server-derived deterministic auto_rule_v1; clients sending scenario are rejected
scope.restart_behavior: terminal tasks, messages, and event metadata recover from SQLite; non-terminal runs marked failed with RUN_INTERRUPTED
scope.session_idempotency_exception: Session bootstrap (/api/v1/session/demo) and logout (/api/v1/session/logout) are explicit G1 exceptions to Idempotency-Key

id_format.description: entity prefix followed by a 26-character uppercase Crockford Base32 ULID

endpoints.rule: checks local configuration, data-directory writability, database connectivity, and current Alembic revision equals head
accepts blank_demo or seeded_demo alias, issues signed HttpOnly cookie
clears demo session cookie regardless of state
returns owner-isolated TaskSnapshot with task_text, server-derived scenario, classification provenance, messages, and feedback_events
requires run_status=succeeded, atomically creates feedback_event, memory_job, and feedback.recorded

http_error_mapping.401: SESSION_REQUIRED when cookie is missing, expired, revoked, or tampered
http_error_mapping.404: TASK_NOT_FOUND or job not found; all cross-owner access returns 404
http_error_mapping.409: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT when key matches different request hash, or TASK_NOT_READY_FOR_FEEDBACK when task is not in terminal success
http_error_mapping.422: VALIDATION_ERROR or FEEDBACK_NO_CHANGES when edited_output matches original output
http_error_mapping.async_after_202: TOOL_NOT_FOUND, TOOL_INPUT_INVALID, PROVIDER_TIMEOUT, PROVIDER_ERROR, STREAM_INTERRUPTED, or RUN_INTERRUPTED
